scientific_integrity: The proof is elementary and self-contained. Independent-point product counting and rough-set lattice products are prior mathematical concepts, not claimed as new. Finite computation checks examples, not general theorems.
scientific_limitations: Exact full probability law and known common sampling parameter are required.
Singleton blocks are invisible if universe size is not known.
Sampling noise, dependent point selection and unknown sampling parameter are not covered.
Earlier equivalent formulations under alternative terminology remain possible; independent publication-priority verification was not performed.
title: Boundary-size laws reconstruct finite rough granulations beyond their rough-set lattices
